summary: Write acceptance criteria as externally observable behavior, not implementation structure; review test oracles against the spec so correct alternative implementations pass and only behavioral violations fail.

evidence.summary: 2026 SDD guide: versioned structured specifications as source of truth; community reports 60-80% fewer rework cycles vs prompt-driven development.
20,574-session study: incomplete upfront specification is the norm; turn-by-turn intent refinement drives misalignment.

not_for: performance-critical code where structure is the requirement

risks: Purely behavioral tests may under-constrain non-functional properties; pair with A10.
